title: WIDGET/ Esthetic/ Change background color intensity
symptom: The widget's background color is a massive gray block that looks old compared to other widgets, and the user requests the ability to change the saturation of the background color.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit that changed the background to a drawable with rounded corners, as suggested by MilosKozak. The user also mentioned using views.setInt(R.id.widget_layout, "setBackgroundResource", R.color.black_alpha_40) as an alternative, but MilosKozak noted that setBackgroundResource doesn't have rounded corners.
